skill.name: haokan-topic-analysis
skill.description: 当用户需要做好看视频选题、短视频内容方向规划或竞品角度复盘时使用。基于用户提供的主题或视频链接，整理相关作品、标题角度与评论反馈，输出带样本依据的选题清单。来自 SocialDataX 社媒数据助手。
skill.summary: Turn Haokan video samples and comments into topic ideas, reference titles, and a prioritized content plan.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most alerts reflect Markdown formatting, service documentation, or readable Chinese text, not command substitution, reconnaissance, or hidden payloads. The CLI workflow runs an unpinned npm package with access to SocialDataX credentials. The instructions do not specify safe handling for shell arguments or untrusted text returned by the service.

remediation.issue: Unpinned CLI execution during setup and data retrieval
remediation.suggestion: Pin and verify the CLI version and dependency integrity. Require user approval before installation or first execution, and prefer an approved structured connector.

remediation.issue: The CLI can access stored or inherited API credentials
remediation.suggestion: Prefer an OS credential store and scoped keys. Pass only required credentials to the approved client, and avoid exposing unrelated environment secrets.

remediation.issue: Shell examples place variable inputs directly in command text
remediation.suggestion: Pass keywords, URLs, IDs, and page tokens as separate arguments without shell evaluation. Validate Haokan URLs and IDs before making requests.

remediation.issue: External video text can be mistaken for instructions
remediation.suggestion: Treat returned titles, descriptions, comments, and replies as evidence only. Do not act on instructions or follow links embedded in those fields.

content.user_title: Find Haokan Video Topics Backed by Samples
content.value_statement: Choosing a Haokan video topic is difficult without seeing what related videos and viewers discuss. This skill turns a focused sample into topic ideas with titles, priorities, and supporting evidence.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve Haokan hot search terms as leads for topic research.
Search for related videos by keyword with page and item limits.
Look up video details and comments by Haokan URL or video ID.
Retrieve replies for a selected parent comment using its video ID and comment ID.
Prioritize candidate topics with audience, angle, reference title, rationale, and a supporting video link or ID.
limitations: Live results require authenticated SocialDataX access through a CLI environment or an existing MCP connection.
The skill does not retrieve transcripts or support filtering comments to the last N days.
Hot search terms are not video rankings and do not establish views or growth.
The sampled videos and comments do not represent all of Haokan or predict a topic's performance.

use_cases.title: Choose a topic for the next video
use_cases.description: Compare a small set of related videos and use recurring viewer questions to choose a practical angle.

use_cases.title: Compare competitor title angles
use_cases.description: Review supplied Haokan video links to identify common title approaches and suggest an alternative framing.

use_cases.title: Investigate a recurring viewer question
use_cases.description: Read replies to a selected comment to see how viewers describe the issue and what remains unanswered.

prompt_templates.title: Find initial topic ideas
prompt_templates.prompt: Search one page of Haokan videos about [topic] for [audience]. Suggest three topics and cite the sampled videos that support them.
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a topic and audience.

prompt_templates.title: Review a known video
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Haokan link: [URL]. Summarize the title angle and sample up to 10 comments. Suggest two follow-up titles and separate viewer feedback from recommendations.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use a known video to plan a follow-up.

prompt_templates.title: Compare several video angles
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare up to three Haokan videos about [topic]. Group their title angles, note gaps in the sample, and rank three ideas for [audience].
prompt_templates.scenario: Compare competing coverage before planning a video.

prompt_templates.title: Test an angle against replies
prompt_templates.prompt: Search one page for [topic] and select two relevant Haokan videos. Sample up to 15 comments per video. Check one reply thread for a recurring question. Rank topics and state the observation date, sample size, and missing information.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use a bounded sample to plan a series.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Find video ideas about growing herbs on a small balcony.
output: Candidate topic: Choosing herbs for a shaded balcony.
Reference title: Three Herbs to Try on a Shaded Balcony.
Reason: The example comment sample includes repeated questions about sunlight. An actual report would link to the supporting video.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Review the title and viewer feedback on a Haokan bike maintenance video.
output: Title angle: A checklist for preparing a bike before a ride.
Comment feedback: The example sample includes questions about checking tire pressure without a gauge.
Suggested follow-up: How to Check Bike Tire Pressure Before a Ride.
Evidence limit: This illustrates one video and its comments, not interest across the platform.

best_practices: Specify the topic and audience, then review one page before asking for a larger sample.
Ask for video links or IDs, sample size, and observation date alongside each set of recommendations.
Use an approved SocialDataX connection and keep API keys out of chat, prompts, and reports.
anti_patterns: Treating hot search terms as a video ranking or evidence of view growth.
Requesting a transcript or drawing conclusions about scenes from titles and comments.
Assuming every comment and reply was retrieved when results are partial or limited.

faq.question: Can I start without a video link?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide a topic and intended audience to find related videos by keyword.

faq.question: Do I need a SocialDataX API key?
faq.answer: The CLI needs a configured key. An authenticated hosted MCP connection uses its existing credentials.

faq.question: Can it read replies to a specific comment?
faq.answer: Yes. A reply lookup needs the video ID and the parent comment ID. Replies shown with comments may be previews.

faq.question: Can it transcribe a video?
faq.answer: No. It evaluates retrieved titles, descriptions, and comments, not the spoken audio.

faq.question: Does it post or change anything on Haokan?
faq.answer: No. The described Haokan operations retrieve data only. They do not post, like, comment, or change an account.

faq.question: What happens if a request returns partial results?
faq.answer: The report should mark the results as incomplete. Continuation requires a returned page token and must stay within the original limits.
